name: Glycine riboswitch aptamer 1 bound to glycine
notes: Glycine riboswitch tandem aptamer I from Fusobacterium nucleatum at 2.80 Å. GLY is glycine (MW 75, 5 atoms). Smallest RNA-binding ligand in the dataset. No aromatic rings, no phosphate → tests backbone-only electrostatic contacts. Chain A (aptamer I) used; GLY residue 89. CCC and GDP are crystallographic artifacts stripped. Mg retained. Note: at 5 atoms, PDBQT preparation is challenging and pose quality unreliable. Ref: Butler et al. 2011 Nat Struct Mol Biol.
